source.speaker: Huilan Chen
source.text: Good morning, Boss Zhang. Yang Zhao and I have registered for and tried EcoTrace's free version. Our initial conclusion is that its user onboarding process is very streamlined and easy to get started with. However, the free features are very limited, basically only providing a basic framework for core enterprises to assign data entry tasks to suppliers, with almost no data analysis or reporting functions. Users who want to get real value must upgrade to the paid version. I am currently compiling a detailed experience analysis and screenshots, which I expect to send out this afternoon.

source.speaker: Huilan Chen
source.text: @all Good morning, I have completed the analysis report on our main competitors. It focuses on EcoTrace's features, pricing, and market strategy, especially their Freemium model and user conversion path. The report has been uploaded to Confluence: https://sd.confluence.net/wiki/spaces/SCT/pages/20250131/EcoTrace+Competitive+Analysis+Report. @Weihua Zhang @Jianguo Huang @Guohua Han The core conclusion is that they use a minimalist free collaboration feature as a traffic entry point, and then set up a paywall through powerful data analysis and reporting functions. This strategy is very much worth learning from.
